snippet.title: Magic: the Gathering gameplay (PC Game, 1997)
snippet.description:
Gameplay for Magic: the Gathering, PC game produced by Microprose in 1997 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/magic-the-gathering/2115/
Trying to play a duel against computer in the most famous card game.
Played through emulated Windows (Win 98/Win XP) virtual machine.
Recorded with original sound.
